profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: As a software developer and more importantly a lifelong learner, I thrive on challenges and constantly seek opportunities to expand my knowledge and skills.

positions.title: Chief Scribe
positions.description: In addition to my duties as a medical scribe, I am tasked with administrative duties involving the scribing program within my department including scheduling, training new scribes and implementing them into the clinic. I act as a link between physicians/hospital staff and the scribes that work for them, ensuring that scribes are performing up to the company's standards and to the provider's satisfaction.

positions.title: Medical Scribe
positions.description: This work consists of working alongside various physicians in the outpatient clinic setting by learning and using the electronic medical record system to provide accurate note-taking while the physician examines patients with the overall goal of facilitating a better work flow  and allow the physician to help more patients.
